messages:
ravi.p: Quick internal note — Dedicated 'Vulcan-560' pools will land in europe-central2 (berlin) as a reserved-preview next Thu 2026-08-05 16:00 CEST. Docs & perf: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/vulcan-560-berlin
claire.ops: Reserved-preview only for 72h. Existing Dedicated customers can request migration. Self-serve reservations will open after stabilization window.
ops-bot: @channel Provisioning window: 2026-08-05 16:00-18:00 CEST. Expect CA rebalancing in europe-central2. No planned customer downtime.
marta.sales: Sales heads-up: do not promise self-serve capacity until we flip the open-reservations flag (target 2026-08-08). We'll share quota guidance shortly.
sre-lead: Hardware summary: Vulcan-560 = ~560 TOPS int8 class, 224GB HBM, optimized for long-context KV caching and memory-heavy models. Early internal perf: 1.3-1.6x token throughput vs our current H100 baseline for 4k+ contexts. See docs link for tables.
claire.ops: Policy & limits: default per-account replica cap = 4 during preview. Cross-zone burst borrowing will be disabled for 48h post-launch to ensure placement stability. If a customer needs >4 replicas, file infra-ops with expected QPS and model profile.
product-comm: Billing note: base per-token units unchanged; we will apply a small 6% "vulcan_preview" uplift on reserved reservations during preview to help cover ramp costs. Remove uplift after GA.
devex: Console UX question: will we surface tuning suggestions for customers migrating?
ravi.p: Yes — Console will show a "Vulcan migration checklist" with recommended batching, KV cache settings, and a one-click sample autoscale snippet. Posting a quick example for infra teams below:
```
# example autoscale policy for vulcan-berlin
pool: vulcan-berlin-1
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 20
burst_slots: 3
default_replica_cap_per_account: 4
priority: dedicated_reserved
```
marta.sales: Are there SLA changes for reserved customers?
sre-lead: No SLA changes. We will call out preview isolation knobs and per-account caps explicitly in the bulletin.
claire.ops: Ops checklist: enable stricter eviction thresholds during first 48h; monitor KV cache hit-rate and tail-latency. Oncall will watch provisioning window and open an incident channel if p99 or 5xxs spike.
ops-bot: Reminder: post-launch checks include tail-latency dashboards, KV eviction events, and tenant replica distribution. Tag @sre-lead if you see anomalies.
product-comm: We'll publish the customer bulletin tomorrow 09:30 UTC with migration playbook, rollback steps, and FAQ. Please review the draft in #eng-runtime and leave comments.
devex: I'll add a quickstart, common troubleshooting Qs, and the fine-tuned autoscale examples to the Console flow.
marta.sales: Acknowledged. We'll hold off outbound GTM until the bulletin goes live.
ravi.p: Final ask: do not promise uncapped self-serve capacity to customers until the preview caps are lifted. If anything odd shows up during provisioning ping @sre-lead immediately. Thanks folks :rocket:
